text:
Ethan (Sales): FYI — GlobalRetail wants a short-term reservation bump for their POC. They want +3 GPUs (dp-77) for a 24hr daytime window (2024-07-05 14:00 to 2024-07-06 14:00 UTC). Also asked for scoped API keys for their on-call and an SLA exception for the demo (higher burst headroom). Can infra + security advise?
Rina (Solutions): Couple clarifying things: 1) which model are they running? 2) expected concurrency and token lengths? 3) will they need private VPC egress (outbound to their analytics)?
Lee (Client-SRE): We'll run mix of qa and demo traffic ~220 concurrent connections, model: rw-llama-13b-quant, avg seq 512. No external egress required for demo.
Jon (EngInfra): We can reserve +3 GPUs as a temporary reservation rather than a burst to guarantee headroom. That requires an allocated reservation in dp-77 and will block resources for the window. Parameters we need: start, end, reservation_id, and a payroll chargeback.
Jon (EngInfra): API to create reservation: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/dp-77/reservations 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_TOKEN" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"reservation_name":"gr-poc-20240705","gpus":3,"start_time":"2024-07-05T14:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-07-06T14:00:00Z","hard_cap":true}'```
Nia (Security): For creds: we require scoped service account keys with IP allowlist + short TTL. Also need to record the access in our audit tracker and add the POC to the temporary access register. SOC2 customers sometimes want proof of deletion post-demo.
Jon (EngInfra): We'll generate keys with 48h TTL and require rotation on expiry. RDW CLI: ```rdw iam create-key --service-account gr-poc-sre --scopes "dedicated:pool:dp-77" --expires-in 48h --allowed-ips "203.0.113.0/27"```
Ethan (Sales): On the SLA exception: they want an explicit note that the reservation guarantees capacity for the window (no best-effort). Is that possible?
Jon (EngInfra): Yes — reserved reservations are capacity-guaranteed. We'll annotate the pool with a reservation ticket and mark it as non-preemptible for that window. Ops will still surface metrics but won't evict the reservation.
Finance Bot: Cost calc: 3 GPUs * 24 hours = 72 GPU-hours. Rate $4.75/GPU-hr => $342.00. We can offer a promotional waiver up to $350 for POC. If they exceed heavy usage and request extension, we will invoice pro-rata.
Lee (Client-SRE): Can we limit the reservation to business hours only? Means we request 14:00-20:00 UTC for each day? For the demo they only need prime time.
Rina (Solutions): Would rather schedule a contiguous reservation to avoid scale churn. But if they insist we can schedule two reservations or set autoscale policy to reduce to baseline outside windows.
Jon (EngInfra): Implementation detail: we can do split reservations via API with two blocks. Example two-block call (pseudocode): reservation A for 14:00-20:00 on 7/5, reservation B for 14:00-20:00 on 7/6. But easier to do a single 24h contiguous with 'active_hours' metadata.
Nia (Security): Also add note: ephemeral keys must not have admin scope. Approve only pool actions (submit, logs, metrics). Security approval granted pending allowlist and audit entry.
Deploy Bot: Reservation request received: job-id rb-20240621-342. Validating capacity and applying reservation.
Deploy Bot: Reservation applied ✅ reservation-id rv-gr-20240705-01. Scoped key created: gr-poc-sre-2024-07-05 (expires 2024-07-07T14:00:00Z). Audit ticket AT-592 opened.
Lee (Client-SRE): Confirmed key works. Ran smoke load at 200 connections: p50=180ms p95=520ms. Some spikes at p95 are due to long responses; we'll tune batching.
Rina (Solutions): Recommend fallback route to rw-llama-6b-quant for non-interactive flows to protect latency if usage spikes. Can set routing in Console -> Routes -> POC-Gr -> Fallbacks.
Ethan (Sales): I'll log the POC credit approval with billing and send client the reservation window + key rotation notes.
Finance Bot: Noted. Promotional waiver $350 attached to account GR-TRIAL-2024. Any usage beyond waiver will be invoiced after the event.
Jon (EngInfra): Ops note: If client requests extension, they must open ticket referencing reservation-id rv-gr-20240705-01 at least 4 hours before end_time. We'll require justification and confirm GPU availability.
Nia (Security): Post-demo checklist: revoke keys, capture audit logs, confirm deletion of any exported hashed telemetry, and update temporary access register.
Ethan (Sales): Thanks team — I'll email GlobalRetail with the reservation details, cost waiver confirmation, and the security checklist. Closing thread when client confirms receipt.
Lee (Client-SRE): Received and acknowledged. See you at the demo, thanks everyone :rocket:
